environment.backend: Node + Dawn (webgpu binding) for AVBD; no browser, no rendering

sequence: Rapier CPU-only first, then six AVBD runs serially on one owned hardware device. Each run uses timed pass plus independent per-step validation replay. No renderer.
rawRetention: Raw JSON and CLI logs preserved in lead-local Git recovery evidence, not bundled. This summary omits all timer arrays and legacy means; no timing comparison is qualified.

config.label: Rapier 0.21.0 reference: 10 solver iterations, 1 PGS, sleeping off, CCD off; one run serves every selected AVBD configuration
config.mapping: A and B differ only in AVBD contactMargin, which Rapier does not have

rows.timingReportableReason: Harness v0 never unlocks timing: R3 (10 s resting) cannot be decided in a 120-step window, no matched Rapier configuration is established, and there is one repeat per engine and configuration. Legacy runOne means and quantiles in `run` are combined step-encode plus queue-wait batch averages kept as raw evidence only.

criteria.title: Finite state, quaternion norm
criteria.cadence: each of the replay steps, plus initial and timed-final state

criteria.title: Timed final state equals replay final state
Manifest hash and body counts match the declaration
Body-pair depth / smallest dimension of the pair
Fraction of dynamic bodies below the rest speed
Centre drift / smallest dimension over at least 10 s
criteria.reason: needs at least 10 measured seconds; this window is 2 s

detail.note: diagnostics at the last replay step, not conservation errors

limits: One process per engine, one trial per configuration/scene, two-second fixed-step window, at most104bodies. No broad scale, performance, physical correctness, energy-conservation, World, browser, SDF or M1/GTX1080 qualification.
All three Q1 rows remain unknown because the required resting window is ten seconds.
AVBD Q2 configA fails C3: maxRelativeDepth0.01486035566795163 >0.01. ConfigB is a separate result, never a replacement. Defaults/thresholds unchanged.
Q3 J1 limit0.05m is only a coarse regression guard. Jointed-pair depth remains unjudged.
All native AVBD capacity/colour counts inspected each replay step were zero; finite/rotation/replay criteria passed. No uncaptured or teardown errors.
